# SuPlushies

> SuPlushies is a wholesale distributor of officially licensed trending toys, with offices in the US and China, distributing worldwide: blind boxes, plush, keychains, figures and trading cards from Pokémon, Sanrio, Disney and popular anime. We supply toy and trend stores, supermarkets and grocery stores, convenience stores, clothing and accessory stores, beauty and lifestyle chains, video game stores, card shops, gift boutiques, claw machine operators, online and marketplace sellers, and first-time store owners.

SuPlushies sells wholesale only, to businesses (brick-and-mortar, online and new stores). It does not sell to individual consumers; shoppers can ask their favorite local store to carry SuPlushies at https://suplushies.com/find-a-store
Founded by Su Chen. Offices in the US and China. Every product is officially licensed; licenses are country-specific, so SuPlushies confirms which items each buyer can sell in their market when it quotes.
To open a wholesale account or request a quote, apply at https://suplushies.com/wholesale#apply (the application is required for every new account). Other questions: https://suplushies.com/contact. New sellers: https://suplushies.com/start-selling

## Best sellers
Pokémon is our biggest category. In order of demand:
1. [Pokémon trading cards](https://suplushies.com/catalog/?license=Pok%C3%A9mon&category=cards-stickers): booster boxes, card packs, collection sets and coin sets, including the TCG 30th Anniversary Celebration and Scarlet & Violet series.
2. [Eevee and the Eeveelutions](https://suplushies.com/catalog/?license=Pok%C3%A9mon&category=blind-boxes): Eevee blind boxes and figures with Sylveon, Umbreon, Espeon and the other Eevee evolutions.
3. [Other Pokémon toys](https://suplushies.com/catalog/?license=Pok%C3%A9mon): Pikachu, Charmander, Snorlax, Gengar and more as plush, figures, blind boxes and keychains.
4. Then Sanrio, Disney, anime and 30+ more licenses.

## Catalog
286 items across 36 licenses and brands.
- [Blind boxes](https://suplushies.com/catalog?category=blind-boxes): 89 items. Collectible mystery figures and plush, sold by the display.
- [Plush](https://suplushies.com/catalog?category=plush): 72 items. Character plush from 8 to 20 inches.
- [Keychains](https://suplushies.com/catalog?category=keychains): 72 items. Bag charms and plush keychains for the checkout counter.
- [Figures](https://suplushies.com/catalog?category=figures): 31 items. Display figures, from desk-size to statement pieces.
- [Cards & stickers](https://suplushies.com/catalog?category=cards-stickers): 22 items. Trading card packs, collection sets and foam stickers.

Licenses and brands: Care Bears, Chiikawa, Cinnamoroll, CRYBABY, DanDaDan, Disney Princess, Dragon Ball Z, Evangelion, Frieren, Haikyu!!, Hatsune Miku, Hello Kitty, How to Train Your Dragon, I'm Not Fat Tiger, Jujutsu Kaisen, Kuromi, Line Dog, MayMei, Miffy, Mofusand, My Little Pony, My Melody, Naruto, Nommi, One Piece, Peanuts, Pochacco, Pokémon, Rilakkuma, Sandy the Fortune Cat, Sanrio, Stitch, The Apothecary Diaries, The Legend of Hei, Toy Story, Winnie the Pooh.

## Who we supply
- [Supermarkets and grocery stores](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#supermarkets-grocery): Supermarkets already work with dozens of food vendors; their toy aisles don't need more. SuPlushies becomes the single supplier for a supermarket's toy shelves: we pick the assortment for its shoppers, ship it by the display so it's quick to put out, and refresh it as trends change. A natural fit for Asian and international supermarkets.
- [Toy stores and trend stores](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#trending-toy-stores): Your shoppers come in asking for whatever went viral this week. We follow what collectors are chasing in Asia and the US, so new series reach your shelves while they're still hot.
- [Beauty and lifestyle stores](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#beauty-lifestyle-stores): Cute characters and beauty shoppers overlap almost completely. Many beauty chains now run a toy section, and we can supply the whole thing, curated and refreshed so your team doesn't have to chase trends.
- [Video game stores](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#video-game-stores): Gamers and anime fans are the same customer. Plush, figures and blind boxes from the series they already love raise basket size without taking space from games.
- [Trading card and hobby shops](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#card-hobby-shops): Your customers already collect. Blind boxes and figures scratch the same itch as a booster pack, and they sell to the friends and parents who come along.
- [Claw machine operators, arcades and entertainment centers](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#arcades-claw-machines): Players chase prizes they recognize. Licensed character plush in prize-friendly sizes keeps machines played and gives your redemption counter something people want.
- [Clothing, accessory and gift stores](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#gift-apparel-boutiques): Clothing and accessory stores sell a look, and a character bag charm finishes it. Small, giftable items keep the store feeling new, and our plush keychains and blind boxes sit naturally beside bags, jewelry, hair accessories and stationery.
- [Bookstores and comic shops](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#bookstores-comic-shops): Manga readers want to take the story home. Character goods from the series on your shelves are a natural add-on, especially for anime with a new season out.
- [Museum, zoo and aquarium gift shops](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#museum-zoo-gift-shops): Visitors want a souvenir that feels special. Animal characters and our own Mighty Su line, a story about animals from different lands sharing one home, fit naturally.
- [Boba, dessert and café counters](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#cafes-dessert-shops): Customers wait a few minutes for every order. A small blind box display by the register earns from that wait, and it suits the cute, shareable feel of many dessert shops.
- [Online stores and marketplace sellers](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#online-stores): If you sell online, you need product that's in demand and easy to list. Every item comes with a UPC, and our catalog photos give you a head start on listings.
- [Convenience stores, pharmacies and checkout lanes](https://suplushies.com/who-we-supply#convenience-checkout): Keychains and small blind boxes are made for the last few feet before the register: low price, high recognition, no explanation needed.

## Frequently asked questions
### Are your products licensed?
Yes. Everything we carry is officially licensed. Each license sets the countries where a product can be sold, so we confirm which items are available for your market before you order.

### Who can buy from SuPlushies?
We sell wholesale to retailers: brick-and-mortar stores, chains, online and marketplace sellers, and people opening their first store. We don't sell to individual shoppers, but they can find a store that carries us on our store finder.

### How do I get wholesale pricing?
Apply for a wholesale account. Once you're approved, usually within 1–2 business days, we send our price list with case packs and current availability.

### What kinds of products do you carry?
Blind boxes, character plush from 4 to 20 inches, plush and vinyl keychains, display figures, trading cards and stickers, from Pokémon, Sanrio, Disney, popular anime and designer-toy brands.

### Where do you ship from?
SuPlushies has offices in the US and China and distributes worldwide. Tell us where your store is and where you sell, and we'll quote the items licensed for your market and the best way to ship them.

### Can you supply a whole toy section for a chain?
Yes. We work with multi-location retailers as the single supplier for their toy sections, choosing the assortment and refreshing it as trends change.

### I'm just starting out. Can I still buy wholesale?
Yes. New stores, pop-ups and online sellers are welcome. Request a starter assortment and tell us your budget and timeline: https://suplushies.com/start-selling

### Which countries do you supply?
We distribute worldwide from offices in the US and China. Licenses vary by country, so availability is confirmed for your market when we quote.

### Can SuPlushies be the only toy vendor for our supermarket's toy aisles?
Yes. Supermarkets and grocery stores use us as their single toy supplier. We choose an assortment for your shoppers and shelf space, ship it by the display so it's quick to put out, and refresh it as trends change. When you apply, tell us how many aisles or feet of shelf you have for toys.

## Mighty Su
Mighty Su is SuPlushies' original character universe about belonging. Each series keeps the same characters in a new setting, with Su in a new role. Series 1 is The Mighty Zoo: eight animals from different lands share one home, watched over by the Mighty Zookeeper (Su). A planned Series 2, The Mighty School, casts Su as the Mighty Principal. Mighty Su collectibles will launch with SuPlushies retail partners first.

### Characters (Series 1: The Mighty Zoo)
- [The Mighty Zookeeper](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/zookeeper): Guardian, The Nurturing Sage. "Even the wildest hearts can find their rhythm."
- [Workhorse](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/workhorse): Donkey, The Overworked Provider. "Keeps the wheels turning."
- [Negative Natalie](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/natalie): Bunny, The Pessimist. "If it can go wrong, it will."
- [Smarty Pants](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/smarty): Owl, The Know-It-All. "Knowledge is power… and I've got all of it."
- [Generous Piggy](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/piggy): Hippo, The Giver. "Here, take mine."
- [Chaos Cat](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/chaos): Leopard Cub, The Mischief-Maker. "Rules? Never heard of 'em."
- [Drama Llama](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/drama): Giraffe, The Diva. "Did you SEE what just happened?!"
- [Chill Panda](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/panda): Giant Panda, The Zen One. "Take it easy."
- [Fearless Cub](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/characters/lion): Lion Cub, The Protector. "I've got your back."
- [Which Mighty Zoo character are you? (quiz)](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/quiz)

### Stories
Short read-aloud stories set in the Mighty Zoo. Each has a main character and supporting characters, shows that a bad moment isn't who someone is, and ends with a life lesson.
- [Fearless Cub and the Other Side of the Fence](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/fearless-cub-and-the-other-side-of-the-fence): Fearless Cub slips out of the zoo to see the big world, and learns what home really is when the storm rolls in. Lesson: Be curious, and go explore. But the grass isn’t always greener on the other side. Home isn’t only where your heart is; it’s your shelter from the storm. When the sky turns dark, bet on family.
- [Natalie and the Cloudy Picnic](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/natalie-and-the-cloudy-picnic): Natalie’s worrying spoils the fun, until the rain arrives and her worrying saves the day. Then two friends say sorry. Lesson: A gloomy mood is like weather. It rolls in, and it rolls out. Don’t let one cloudy moment become someone’s name, and that includes your own.
- [The Day Chaos Cat Got Blamed](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/the-day-chaos-cat-got-blamed): When Panda’s lotus pots are knocked over, everyone is sure the mischief-maker did it. Everyone except Panda. Lesson: What someone did yesterday doesn’t decide what they did today. Check before you blame, and leave the door open for people to surprise you.
- [Workhorse’s Grumpy Morning](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/workhorses-grumpy-morning): Workhorse is up before the sun and too tired to be kind. A bad morning, it turns out, is not the same as a bad heart. Lesson: A bad morning doesn’t make a bad heart. When you snap, say sorry. Then rest, eat something, and let someone carry a bucket.
- [Drama Llama and the Talent Night](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/drama-llama-and-the-talent-night): Drama Llama has the biggest act at Talent Night. Then she notices a friend who never got a turn. Lesson: The spotlight gets brighter when you share it. And if you’re waiting for a turn, it’s okay to ask for one.
- [Generous Piggy Says “Not Today”](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/generous-piggy-says-not-today): Piggy gives away every snack, blanket and hug, until there’s nothing left for her. Then she snaps, and everyone is surprised. Lesson: You can’t pour from an empty cup. Saying “not today” sometimes is how you keep having love to give.
- [Smarty Pants and the Hedge Maze](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/smarty-pants-and-the-hedge-maze): Smarty Pants knows the way through the zoo’s new hedge maze. Definitely. Probably. Until three friends are very, very lost. Lesson: “I don’t know” is a brave sentence. The smartest thing you can do is ask, and listen to what your friends already know.
- [Chill Panda Loses His Cool](https://suplushies.com/mighty-su/stories/chill-panda-loses-his-cool): Everyone brings their problems to calm, steady Panda. Nobody asks how Panda is doing, until the day he shouts. Lesson: Calm friends have storms too. Ask the steady ones how they’re doing, and wait for the real answer.
